expression_restriction.value: Neutral facial expression with closed lips, eyes open and focused on camera

glasses_policy.value: No glasses, earrings, or hats; no clothing/accessories that prevent face from being seen

face_visibility.value: Face must be completely visible; hair must not cover face; head not tilted or turned

headwear_policy.value: Hats prohibited; religious head covering acceptable provided face remains fully visible with no shadows

accessories.value: No glasses, earrings, hats, or clothing/accessories that will prevent face from being seen

size.evidence: The official Turkish MFA Los Angeles consulate page was fetched directly and states: 'The biometric passport photo size must be 50 mm x 60 mm (As 2*2' is commonly used in the USA, the said dimension is also acceptable).' This matches the claimed value exactly. Multiple independent sources (visafoto.com, makepassportphoto.com, mybiometricphotos.com, photoaid.com) all consistently cite 50x60mm for Turkey visa photos.
